messages:
Claire: Heads up — kicking off the cloud marketplace onboarding for the Private Offer. I uploaded a rough checklist (link) and a sample SKU draft. Need quick calls on SKU naming, AMI region coverage, and EULA trial language before legal signs off. @Ravi can you confirm AMI region parity for gov/eu?
Ravi: On it. I need the final AMI ids and which regions are mandatory vs optional. Do we want us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1 as the minimum?
Claire: Minimum sounds right. Also want to support ap-southeast-1 eventually but mark as optional for GA.
Sam: For SKU naming, propose: redwood-inference-<edition>-<tier>-<region>. Example: redwood-inference-enterprise-1u-us. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maria: That matches what Azure expects for offer ids. For GCP we do a separate product id but keep user-facing SKU similar.
Ken: Legal: need to flag two items — (1) trial period clause must say 'up to 14 days' and include auto-conversion opt-in language, (2) data processing addendum reference for EU. I'll add text.
Claire: Perfect. Can you paste the exact wording you'll add? Retail packaging needs to show trial vs paid behavior clearly.
Ken: Draft: "Trial license valid for up to 14 days. By activating the trial you consent to auto-conversion to paid billing unless cancelled prior to trial end. Data processing governed by DPA v2 (link)." Ping me if marketplace requires different phrasing.
Ravi: AMI note — we have optimized arm64 quantized builds in us-east-1/us-west-2 only. x86 builds are in all three mandatory regions. If arm64 is required for the SKU we need to mark region constraints in the offer.
Sam: Ok add a SKU attribute: "arch=arm64" or "arch=x86_64" so we can map buyers to compatible SKUs. Can the marketplace show that?
Maria: Yes, we can include architecture in the SKU metadata. Also need the container image digest and SBOM link for listing.
Claire: Action items summarized: 1) Ravi to provide AMI ids and region matrix (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Ken to drop final trial/EULA copy into the checklist (due today). 3) Sam to finalize SKU naming and metadata attributes and post the sample CSV for ingestion. 4) Maria to attach image digests and SBOM links. 5) I'll schedule a 15m gating call once the above are in.
Ravi: Added AMI draft to the checklist page: ami-rl-001 (x86) in mandatory regions; arm64 tagged ami-rl-arm-01 in us-east-1/us-west-2. Note: arm images are ~2% faster for small-batch but less tested on large seqs.
Sam: Uploaded sample SKU CSV: ``sku,display_name,arch,regions,price_plan
redwood-inference-enterprise-1u-us,Enterprise - 1 unit,x86_64,us-east-1|us-west-2|eu-west-1,monthly``
Maria: SBOM link posted: https://artifacts.redwood/inventory/rl_sbom_2026-03-20.json and container digest sha256:abc123...
deploy-bot: Marketplace lint report: 3 warnings — missing trial-dismiss copy in package display, ambiguous region mapping for arm SKUs, missing DPA attachment. See /lint/1717776666-report.
Claire: Thanks team. I'll triage warnings on the call. If anyone can't make the 15m sync, drop final bits into the checklist and ping me. :thumbsup:
